title: Medical Notes on Climate, Diseases, Hospitals, and Medical Schools, in France, Italy, and Switzerland
version: First edition, London, T. and G. Underwood, 1820. Internet Archive scan identifier medicalnotesoncl00clar.
lineage: Contemporary observations at Paris hospitals and donor’s account of bringing an instrument from Paris. The English physician’s use is reported second-hand by Clark.

passages.locator: Title page (PDF page 5); printed pp. 153–154 (PDF pages 183–184)
passages.note: Clark visited Necker, where physician Cayol showed him cases assessed with the stethoscope. He reports Récamier’s continuing use at Hôtel-Dieu.
Clark says he gave a stethoscope he brought from Paris to an unnamed English physician, who told him he had used it in investigating cardiac disease.
